notes: tx_pos is a helper counter: value m means the current edge is E0+m (0 = idle). Assertions sample pre-edge values, so tx_pos describes the current sampled edge. CHK-013's idle-high run is also enforced by CHK-010(b), and the 0 at E1+1 is checked via tx_pos==1. A back-to-back accept at E0+10N restarts tx_pos at 1, and the stop-bit 1 at E0+10N is checked by CHK-011.
